  "residence_time_min": 10.0,
  "flow_rate_mL_min": 0.5,
  "temperature_C": 50,
  "concentration_M": 0.12,
  "BPR_bar": 5.0,
  "reactor_type": "Temperature-controlled tubular flow coil with a low-dead-volume three-inlet static micromixer upstream; no microwave irradiation.",
  "tubing_material": "PFA",
  "tubing_ID_mm": 1.0,
  "reactor_volume_mL": 5.0,
  "residence_time_basis": "Liquid-filled reactor residence time calculated as reactor liquid volume divided by the summed liquid inlet flow rate. No gas is intentionally introduced.",
  "residence_time_inlet_min": 10.0,
  "residence_time_in_channel_min": 10.0,
  "light_setup": "None. The batch microwave condition is translated initially to conventional thermal flow heating at the same nominal bulk temperature. Microwave-specific heating effects are not assumed to transfer directly.",
  "wavelength_nm": null,
  "streams": [
    {
      "stream_label": "A",
      "pump_role": "Aryl-halide/catalyst feed",
      "contents": "Aromatic bromide, 0.150 M; Pd(PPh3)4, 0.00150 M (1.0 mol% relative to aromatic bromide). Assumption: Pd(PPh3)4 is a suitable soluble catalyst for the unspecified batch catalyst system.",
      "solvent": "Anhydrous DMF",
      "phase": "Single liquid phase",
      "flow_rate_mL_min": 0.2,
      "concentration_M": 0.15,
      "molar_equiv": 1.0,
      "gas_flow_sccm": 0,
      "gas_flow_actual_mL_min": 0
    },
    {
      "stream_label": "B",
      "pump_role": "Boronic-acid feed",
      "contents": "Phenylboronic acid derivative, 0.225 M.",
      "solvent": "DMF",
      "phase": "Single liquid phase",
      "flow_rate_mL_min": 0.2,
      "concentration_M": 0.225,
      "molar_equiv": 1.5,
      "gas_flow_sccm": 0,
      "gas_flow_actual_mL_min": 0
    },
    {
      "stream_label": "C",
      "pump_role": "Base feed",
      "contents": "Potassium carbonate, 1.20 M. Assumption: K2CO3 is selected as a readily available aqueous inorganic base because the batch base was unspecified.",
      "solvent": "Deionized water",
      "phase": "Single liquid phase before mixing; may form a DMF/water liquid-liquid or salt-containing multiphase system after mixing",
      "flow_rate_mL_min": 0.1,
      "concentration_M": 1.2,
      "molar_equiv": 2.0,
      "gas_flow_sccm": 0,
      "gas_flow_actual_mL_min": 0
    }
  ],
  "mixer_type": "Three-inlet low-dead-volume static micromixer or interdigital micromixer, followed immediately by the heated coil.",
  "mixing_order_reasoning": "Streams A and B are introduced simultaneously with stream C at the final micromixer, with less than approximately 0.05 mL pre-reactor mixed hold-up. This minimizes premature exposure of the palladium/aryl bromide/boronic acid mixture to base before entering the controlled-temperature reactor, while providing rapid dispersion of the aqueous base into the DMF-rich reaction stream.",
  "pre_reactor_steps": [
    "Prepare Stream A under nitrogen or argon if the selected palladium catalyst is air-sensitive; protect from prolonged ambient-air exposure.",
    "Filter all feeds through a 0.2-0.45 micrometer chemically compatible filter before pumping to remove particulate matter that could plug the micromixer or 1.0 mm-ID coil.",
    "Degas DMF feeds by sparging or freeze-pump-thaw only if oxygen sensitivity is observed; do not intentionally introduce a gas stream into the reactor.",
    "Prime each pump separately, establish stable liquid flows, then bring the three streams together at ambient temperature.",
    "Preheat the reactor block or bath to 50 C before directing mixed reaction fluid through the coil.",
    "Discard at least three reactor volumes after changing conditions before collecting a representative steady-state sample."
  ],
  "post_reactor_steps": [
    "Pass the reactor effluent through the 5 bar back-pressure regulator while maintaining the regulator and downstream line sufficiently warm to avoid salt deposition.",
    "Collect effluent into a stirred, cooled vessel containing ethyl acetate and water, or directly collect into a vessel for off-line liquid-liquid extraction.",
    "Separate the aqueous phase, wash the organic phase with water and brine, dry over sodium sulfate, and concentrate.",
    "Analyze crude conversion and product selectivity by HPLC, GC, or LC-MS before purification.",
    "Purify the biaryl product by flash chromatography or crystallization as appropriate for the specific substrate.",
    "After the run, flush first with DMF/water, then water, then DMF or another compatible organic solvent. Do not allow carbonate-containing material to dry inside the coil or BPR."
  ],
  "chemistry_notes": {
    "reaction_class": "Assumed Suzuki-Miyaura cross-coupling of an aromatic bromide with a phenylboronic acid derivative.",
    "nominal_reactor_composition": {
      "aromatic_bromide_M": 0.12,
      "boronic_acid_M": 0.18,
      "K2CO3_M": 0.24,
      "Pd_PPh3_4_M": 0.0006,
      "DMF_water_volume_ratio": "4:1"
    },
    "starting_condition_rationale": "The initial residence time and bulk temperature intentionally match the reported batch microwave setpoint of 50 C for 10 min. This is a screening starting point, not an assertion that identical conversion or the reported 91% isolated yield will result without microwave heating.",
    "expected_throughput": "At 0.120 M aromatic bromide and 0.500 mL/min total liquid flow, substrate throughput is 0.060 mmol/min, equivalent to 3.6 mmol/h.",
    "important_unknowns": [
      "Identity and loading of the batch palladium catalyst were not provided.",
      "Identity and equivalents of the batch base were not provided.",
      "The aromatic bromide and boronic-acid substituents were not specified; their electronic and steric properties can substantially change catalyst choice, conversion, and required residence time.",
      "The reported microwave protocol may benefit from microwave-specific heating or mixing effects that conventional heated flow does not reproduce."
    ],
    "optimization_priority": [
      "Verify conversion at 50 C and 10 min by steady-state sampling.",
      "If conversion is below target, first test 60-80 C and/or 15-20 min residence time, subject to substrate stability.",
      "If catalyst precipitation or low activity occurs, screen a more robust soluble precatalyst such as Pd(dppf)Cl2 or a suitable Buchwald-type palladium precatalyst.",
      "If phase separation gives unstable conversion, increase aqueous/organic mixing intensity, modestly increase water content, or use a fully soluble base/catalyst system after compatibility testing."
    ]
  },
  "stage_parameters": [
    {
      "stage": "Feed preparation",
      "temperature_C": 20,
      "pressure_bar": 1,
      "total_flow_mL_min": 0.5,
      "hold_up_mL": null,
      "purpose": "Prepare filtered, pumpable homogeneous individual feed solutions."
    },
    {
      "stage": "Micromixing",
      "temperature_C": 20,
      "pressure_bar": 5,
      "total_flow_mL_min": 0.5,
      "hold_up_mL": 0.05,
      "purpose": "Rapidly combine aryl bromide/catalyst, boronic acid, and aqueous carbonate immediately before heating."
    },
    {
      "stage": "Heated reaction coil",
      "temperature_C": 50,
      "pressure_bar": 5,
      "total_flow_mL_min": 0.5,
      "hold_up_mL": 5.0,
      "residence_time_min": 10.0,
      "purpose": "Thermal Suzuki-Miyaura coupling."
    },
    {
      "stage": "Back-pressure regulation and collection",
      "temperature_C": 30,
      "pressure_bar": 5,
      "total_flow_mL_min": 0.5,
      "hold_up_mL": null,
      "purpose": "Maintain a liquid-filled reactor, then safely depressurize before workup."
    }
  ],
  "reasoning_per_field": {
    "residence_time_min": "Set to the reported 10 min batch microwave irradiation time as an initial directly comparable residence-time screen.",
    "flow_rate_mL_min": "A total flow of 0.500 mL/min provides a practical small-scale throughput while giving exactly 10.0 min residence time in a 5.0 mL reactor.",
    "temperature_C": "Set initially to the reported 50 C bulk temperature; conventional thermal heating may require later adjustment.",
    "concentration_M": "The reported batch reaction concentration was not provided. A 0.120 M final aromatic-bromide concentration is a moderate starting point intended to limit viscosity, improve heat transfer, and retain useful throughput.",
    "BPR_bar": "A 5 bar BPR maintains a liquid-filled system and suppresses solvent outgassing; it is not intended to create a reactive gas pressure because no gas is used.",
    "reactor_type": "A micromixer plus tubular coil is suitable for rapid mixing and controlled residence time in a potentially multiphase DMF/water Suzuki reaction.",
    "tubing_material": "PFA is generally compatible with DMF, aqueous carbonate, and 50 C operation and is convenient for visual inspection of fouling.",
    "tubing_ID_mm": "A 1.0 mm ID reduces plugging risk relative to narrower microchannels when aqueous carbonate and possible palladium solids are present.",
    "reactor_volume_mL": "The reactor volume is calculated from 0.500 mL/min multiplied by 10.0 min, giving 5.0 mL.",
    "residence_time_basis": "The residence time is based on total liquid flow because no gas is fed and liquid compressibility is negligible under these conditions.",
    "light_setup": "The source protocol used microwave irradiation, not photochemistry. No optical wavelength is relevant.",
    "streams": "Three streams keep the catalyst/aryl halide, boronic acid, and inorganic base separately pumpable until the final mixing point.",
    "mixer_type": "High-intensity low-dead-volume mixing is important because the combined DMF/water system may be heterogeneous.",
    "pre_reactor_steps": "Filtration, controlled priming, and inert handling where needed address the main practical risks of palladium catalyst degradation and channel blockage.",
    "post_reactor_steps": "Immediate dilution/extraction and thorough flushing reduce product loss, salt deposition, and palladium-containing residue accumulation."
  },
  "literature_analogies": [
    "This design follows the general continuous-flow Suzuki-Miyaura practice of separately feeding organohalide/catalyst, boronic acid, and base into a heated tubular reactor with short pre-reactor hold-up.",
    "Aqueous carbonate/DMF or aqueous carbonate/polar-aprotic-solvent mixtures are common Suzuki starting systems, but actual phase behavior and catalyst stability must be confirmed for the unspecified substrates.",
    "Conventional heated-flow translation of a microwave batch reaction should be treated as a process-development experiment rather than a one-to-one replacement, because microwave and wall-heated reactors can show different heating profiles and apparent rates."
  ],
  "engine_validated": false,
  "safety_flags": [
    {
      "flag": "DMF exposure hazard",
      "control": "Use a closed feed system, compatible gloves, local exhaust ventilation, and segregated liquid-waste collection. DMF is readily absorbed through skin and should be handled as a hazardous solvent."
    },
    {
      "flag": "Pressurized liquid system",
      "control": "Use pressure-rated tubing, fittings, coil, and BPR rated above the maximum credible pressure; install a pressure sensor upstream of the BPR and a pressure-relief device or automated pump shutdown set below the lowest-rated component limit."
    },
    {
      "flag": "Potential plugging from salts, catalyst solids, or product precipitation",
      "control": "Filter feeds, use 1.0 mm-ID tubing, inspect pressure trend continuously, keep the post-reactor/BPR warm if needed, and stop pumps immediately upon abnormal pressure rise."
    },
    {
      "flag": "Palladium-containing waste",
      "control": "Collect catalyst-containing effluent and solids separately for metal-bearing hazardous-waste handling or palladium recovery; do not dispose of it to drain."
    },
    {
      "flag": "Air-sensitive or moisture-sensitive catalyst possibility",
      "control": "Because the original catalyst was unspecified, prepare and operate Stream A under inert atmosphere if using Pd(PPh3)4 or another oxygen-sensitive catalyst."
    },
    {
      "flag": "No gas flow",
      "control": "Gas-flow fields are explicitly zero. Therefore, no STP-to-in-channel gas-flow correction is applicable."
    }
  ],
  "confidence": {
    "overall": "moderate",
    "basis": "The hydraulic design, stoichiometry, and residence-time calculation are internally consistent. Chemical performance confidence is limited because the specific aromatic bromide, boronic acid derivative, base, catalyst identity, catalyst loading, and batch concentration were not supplied.",
    "assumptions_requiring_experimental_confirmation": [
      "Pd(PPh3)4 at 1 mol% is active and sufficiently stable for the substrate pair.",
      "K2CO3 at 2.0 equivalents is suitable for the intended coupling.",
      "The DMF/water mixture remains adequately mixed in the selected micromixer and 1.0 mm-ID coil.",
      "Thermal flow operation at 50 C and 10 min provides conversion comparable to the microwave batch experiment."
    ]
  }
}
